rca of the issue: Initial check found tab title 'Emergent | Fullstack App' served from the public URL even though source /app/frontend/public/index.html already had the correct <title>NX-360 BMS — Automação Predial</title>. Root cause: Create-React-App's HtmlWebpackPlugin reads public/index.html once at dev-server startup and keeps the processed HTML in memory; hot-reload does NOT re-process public/index.html. Mitigation applied: `sudo supervisorctl restart frontend` — after restart the correct title is served. No code change needed.
